world.title: Kyiv bridge hit in further Russian drone attack as German chancellor makes surprise visit
world.description: Footage shows a drone hitting the Pivnichyi (Northern) Bridge as vehicles move across it, creating a large fireball.

world.title: Watch: What we know about Russian strikes on Kyiv bridges
world.description: BBC Ukraine correspondent Dan Johnson is near Kyiv's Northern Bridge, which has been hit for the second day in a row.

world.title: Yemen's government announces all-out war to reclaim land from Houthis
world.description: The Yemeni president's announcement comes amid an exchange of strikes between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition.

world.title: Polls close in Brazil as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro remain neck and neck
world.description: If no candidate gets more than 50% of the vote, the election will go to a run-off on 25 October.

world.title: Ethiopian rebel forces withdraw from Tigray regional capital
world.description: Two residents in Mekelle tell the BBC pro-government forces have taken control of the city.

world.title: Christa Pike's prognosis still unclear after failed execution, lawyer says
world.description: Pike's lawyer says doctors are still trying to clear two lethal doses of pentobarbital from her body.

world.title: Indian police accused of sexually harassing journalists at protest
world.description: The allegations were made after police detained dozens of protesters demanding the resignation of the election chief over changes to voter rolls.

world.title: US Marine arrested over murder of woman in Okinawa, Japan
world.description: Japan's government lodged a formal protest with the US, demanding that military officials take action.

world.title: Australia investigating Flydubai co-pilot's links to country
world.description: State police and the country's security agency are looking into the co-pilot, who attempted to take control of a Flydubai plane travelling to Israel.

world.title: What to know about Brazil's election as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro face off
world.description: Polls suggest the election will be a closely run contest between the left-wing incumbent and his right-wing rival.

world.title: 'Anger in the streets': Tens of thousands protest in Spain over housing crisis
world.description: More than 50 protests took place on Saturday after the government failed to get emergency legislation through parliament.

world.title: Debris found from plane that went missing off US coast
world.description: The aircraft lost communication with flight controllers after significantly dropping in altitude, according to flight data.

world.title: Cornell president says university 'must do better' after frat house rape allegations
world.description: Michael Kotlikoff described the allegations of a woman who says she was drugged and gang raped as "deeply disturbing".

world.title: US father and son arrested after 'gas station heroin' deaths
world.description: They are accused of selling at least one student derivatives of kratom, often called "gas station heroin" in the US.

world.title: Why Canada is wargaming a (long shot) US invasion
world.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney has said the military is running scenarios in the unlikely case the US invades Canada.

US.title: Brazil votes, with Lula facing Bolsonaro's son
US.description: In Brazil, President Lula da Silva faces Flávio Bolsonaro, son of the jailed former president, in a tight race.  If neither wins more than half the votes they'll face each other again on Oct. 25.

US.title: Trump names national intelligence chief Jay Clayton as new AI czar
US.description: Trump said Clayton will lead the White House's new "Super Intelligence Force," which will coordinate government engagement with artificial intelligence.

US.title: Cornell president calls gang rape allegations 'deeply disturbing'
US.description: Cornell president Michael I. Kotlikoff said his university "must do better" in a video statement. "This is a defining moment in Cornell's history," he added.

US.title: U.S. Marine arrested for alleged murder of a woman in Okinawa, Japan
US.description: Japanese police arrested a U.S. Marine in the alleged robbery and murder of a woman on Okinawa, officials said Sunday.

US.title: How the Cornell case is affecting women who have experienced sexual assault
US.description: The rape allegations that have emerged from a Cornell University frat house are leading many women to remember their own experiences — and call for a wider reckoning over sexual violence.

US.title: She died covering war for Fox News. Her parents blame the network — and a star reporter
US.description: The family members of two Fox News journalists killed while covering the war in Ukraine are suing the network, saying it put getting the story ahead of its people.

US.title: Latter-day Saints women turn away from scandal-plagued Republican candidate in Arizona
US.description: Arizona Republican candidate for Congress Mark Lamb has been accused of sexual misconduct while sheriff. His controversy is turning many voters away as Democrats see an opportunity in the red seat.

US.title: Coast Guard finds debris from medical plane carrying 6 people
US.description: Flight data shows the jet dropped at least 9,000 feet over two minutes, then leveled off for several more minutes, before disappearing.

US.title: Can the Cornell lawsuit force changes that make students safer?
US.description: Universities have responsibilities when students report sexual assault, even if prosecutors don't bring charges. Attorney Baine Kerr explains how those protections work.

US.title: Opinion: A Hawk is not the same as a Hawkeye
US.description: This was emphasized to people watching a Senate hearing this week, where confusion over two basketball teams was on display.
